findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_yield" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_issuer_bonds, get_bond · Private data: get_bond, request_bond · Public sink: get_etf, calculate_yield.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_issuer_bonds, get_bond · Private data: get_bond, request_bond · Public sink: get_etf, calculate_yield

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
